QuestInfo.0: You eliminated the Jr. Cerebes, but the barking continues from the Dead Mine. Perhaps it was something else. Talk to #b#p9073005##k about what he thinks.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: It seems it was the #bJr. Cerebes and Bains#k. #p9073005# needs you to eliminate both monsters so he can hear #p2020007#'s whistles. Return to #p9073005# once you are done with the mission.\r\n\r\n
QuestInfo.2: Thanks to you, #p9073005# is now able to hear #p2020007#'s calling.
